title: Mark an earlier completed past event
instructions: Choose the form that makes the event order explicit.

parts.prompt: By the time the rain started, the volunteers ___ all the seedlings inside.

choice_rationales.A: Had moved marks the completed movement before the later past event started.
choice_rationales.B: Were moving would make the action ongoing when the rain started, contradicting all and the completed order.
choice_rationales.C: Present perfect cannot use the rain's finished past start as its present reference point.
choice_rationales.D: Simple present does not fit the stated past sequence.

parts.hint: By the time sets a later past reference point; identify what was already complete.
parts.correct_explanation: All the seedlings were already inside before the rain started, so past perfect makes the earlier completion clear.
